## Overview

Data Forge Toolkit is a project stub for a reusable working system that turns inconsistent source material into clean, structured project data.

## Context / Problem

Project work often accumulates in notes, spreadsheets, exports, and partial files that are difficult to combine. The main challenge is reducing friction without overbuilding the workflow.

## What I Built

The toolkit combines small parsing, normalization, and export utilities so raw material can be shaped into something stable enough for analysis, publishing, or iteration.

## What I Learned

Useful project tooling usually depends more on clear structure than on complexity. The biggest improvement often comes from making a workflow legible and repeatable.
